title: How a Godly Man Leads a Room That Wants to Blame Someone Else
caption:
The room is looking for someone to pin it on. He's already raised his hand.

Leadership that costs Christ his life for the people he led doesn't start with a title. It starts with being the first man in the room willing to say "that one's on me."

Four ways a godly man leads when something breaks: he owns it out loud first, he lets correction actually land, he fixes it before he's thanked, and he takes the hit so someone else doesn't have to.

Save this for the next meeting that goes sideways.

theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
